contact_sources.quote: Caroline Wirth Head Business Development Caroline joined AQUIS Capital in January 2024 as Head Business Development, having over 15 years’ experience within the hedge funds universe. Before joining AQUIS Capital she was responsible at Mainfirst and Ethenea for the German speaking clients in Switzerland. From 2014 to 2020, she was at Ayaltis AG Senior Hedge Fund Sales. She started her career in 2007 as an Equity Analyst at Credit Suisse before joining Aurium Capital. Caroline Wirth studied economics and politics at University of Southampton and holds a master’s degree in international economics from University of London SOAS.
